violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Wire rack shelving units in walk in cooler have a build up of food debris and need cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Counter under grill has ash/debris build up and needs cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Ceiling and vent near fryers discolored and need cleaning. Floors have accumulated food debris under shelving units and equipment in walk in cooler, prep area, and cook line and need cleaning.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. Bottle of degreaser stored on same shelf as food service pans in dish area. Store chemicals below and away.

Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not accurate or not easily readable. Reach in cooler for lettuce items has broken thermometer. Employee replaced. Temperature gauge to temporary hot hold unit not working. Needs repair.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Counter under char-grill has an accumulation of debris/char. Area around fryer has build-up of grease. Cleaning needed.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors have an accumulation of food/debris along wall junctures, under equipment/shelving, & in harder to reach areas. Need cleaning.
